answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a vital thread in securing AI economies by requiring a cryptographic signal of biological uniqueness. Unlike simple proof-of-work, this protocol forces an attacker to acquire costly, verifiable human credentials for every raven node they attempt to instantiate. Consequently, an adversary faces prohibitive operational expenses proportional to the network size, making large-scale identity fabrication economically irrational and computationally unsustainable.
